description: Four independent 32-step sequencers whose sliders set the probability that each step fires, and whose slider heights also make a pitch

params.text: Sets the root note that all four sequences' pitch outputs are quantised to
Picks the scale the pitch outputs are quantised to, among them the Messiaen modes of limited transposition and the seventh chords
Returns all four sequences to their first step
Picks one of nine preset slider patterns for that sequence
Throws every slider of that sequence to a new random probability
Replaces every slider probability in that sequence with one minus it
Halves that sequence's pattern and repeats it, each press halving what is left
Sets the number of steps that sequence plays before returning to the start, 1 to 32
Scales the pitch taken from that sequence's slider heights, 0 to 100% of the full voltage range

inputs.text: A clock advances all four sequences by one step
A clock advances that sequence by one step
A trigger returns all four sequences to their first step
A gate throws every slider of that sequence to a new random probability
A gate replaces every slider probability in that sequence with one minus it
A gate halves that sequence's pattern and repeats it

outputs.text: Fires 10V while at least one of the four sequences has its gate on
Fires 10V while exactly one of the four sequences has its gate on
Fires 10V at a step of that sequence whose slider wins its probability roll
Fires 10V at a step of that sequence whose slider loses its probability roll
Carries a pitch from the height of that sequence's current slider, quantised to the root note and scale
Carries that sequence's current slider height subtracted from full scale, quantised to the root note and scale

notes: click or drag across a row of sliders to draw its pattern
with keyboard shortcuts enabled, Ctrl with the left and right arrows shifts the focused sliders sideways and Ctrl with the up and down arrows moves them by 5%
the sequencer has no clock of its own: nothing advances until a clock arrives at MCLK or at one of the four individual clock inputs.
the module ships two presets, Drums and Amen break, each filling the four rows of sliders with a drum pattern.
menu: MCLK override — a cable in MCLK disables all four individual clock inputs
Gate mode — Gates, which last the step, or Triggers, which are 1ms long
V/OCT mode — Independent changes the pitch at every step, Sample and Hold changes it only when a gate fires
Volt Offset — takes the pitch from a -5V to +5V range, or from a 0-10V range
Slider Percentages — prints the probability on each slider
Keyboard Shortcuts — turns on ctrl-enter to focus one pattern, ctrl-C and ctrl-V to copy and paste it, and ctrl with the arrows to shift and move its sliders
